turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Good afternoon, Orion Shield Insurance, Marcus speaking. How may I help you?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, I was in a car accident and I need to make a claim. I'm still quite shaken up, to be honest.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Right. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Elena Petrova, 6 March 1950.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's KD1 2PB.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Could you tell me exactly what happened, and when it happened?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It was yesterday around half five, on the ring road near the retail park. A van pulled out and hit the side of my car.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. Was anyone injured, and how extensive is the damage?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thankfully nobody was hurt, but the passenger door and wing are badly dented and it's not really drivable.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Can I confirm the registration number of the vehicle?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's KZ24 RBK.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Why does it take so long? Can't you just speed it up for me?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Well, you really should have read the policy documents when you bought it.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me explain what happens here. We'll acknowledge your claim within 24 hours and the claims team will assess it within 3 working days, so you'll hear very quickly.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks. Our team will be in touch about it.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've taken the details of your claim and passed it to the claims team.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is there anything else I can help you with today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: No, that's everything, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
